description: Department of Labour, Labour Standards Division - The cost of living index number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing trade for the month of October, 2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter concerning wage adjustments and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
